dish.title: Chicken Enchiladas Verdes
dish.description: Broiler-charred tomatillos, jalapeños, onion, and garlic blended with cilantro and lime into a bright salsa verde; broiled cumin chicken thighs shredded with salsa and Monterey Jack, rolled in warm corn tortillas, smothered in more salsa and cheese, and baked until bubbling. Finished with lime crema, diced onion, radishes, and cilantro.

recipe_version.title: Chicken Enchiladas Verdes
recipe_version.description: Broiler-charred tomatillos, jalapeños, onion, and garlic blended with cilantro and lime into a bright salsa verde; broiled cumin chicken thighs shredded with salsa and Monterey Jack, rolled in warm corn tortillas, smothered in more salsa and cheese, and baked until bubbling. Finished with lime crema, diced onion, radishes, and cilantro.

ingredients.name: jalapeños
ingredients.note: keep seeds for heat, remove for mild

ingredients.name: white onion
ingredients.note: medium: half for the salsa, a quarter diced for garnish (the last quarter is spare)
ingredients.preparation: half cut into 2 thick wedges; 1/4 finely diced

ingredients.name: cilantro
ingredients.note: lightly packed; 3/4 cup with tender stems for the salsa, 1/4 cup leaves to finish

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.note: about 2 tbsp juice: 1 tbsp salsa, 1 tbsp crema

ingredients.name: corn tortillas
ingredients.note: 100% corn (masa, water, lime); not a corn-wheat blend

ingredients.name: Monterey Jack cheese
ingredients.note: 2 cups shredded: 1 cup filling, 1 cup topping. Milk allergen.

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.note: thinned into lime crema. Milk allergen.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp for the chicken, 1 tbsp for the tortillas

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: 1/4 cup for blending the salsa, 1 tbsp for the crema

steps.title: Heat the broiler and load the pan
steps.body: Set an oven rack about 6 inches below the broiler and heat the broiler to high; it heats during this prep (overlap stated). Line a rimmed sheet pan with foil. Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp oil, the cumin, 3/4 tsp salt, and the pepper. Arrange the chicken, tomatillos, the two onion wedges, jalapeño halves (cut side down), and unpeeled garlic on the pan in a single layer.

steps.title: Prep the garnishes
steps.body: Finely dice a quarter of the onion. Thinly slice the radishes. Pick 1/4 cup cilantro leaves; roughly chop the rest with tender stems for the salsa. Shred the cheese if using a block. Juice the lime.

steps.title: Broil
steps.body: Broil 6 minutes, until the tomatillos blister and the chicken browns in spots. Flip the chicken and turn the tomatillos; broil 5 to 6 minutes more, until the tomatillos are soft, slumped, and charred in patches and the chicken reaches 175°F. Move the chicken to a board. Switch the oven to bake at 425°F (it is already hot).

steps.title: Blend the salsa verde
steps.body: Squeeze the garlic from its skins. Blend the tomatillos with their juices, broiled onion, jalapeños, garlic, 3/4 cup chopped cilantro, 1 tbsp lime juice, 3/4 tsp salt, and 1/4 cup water until smooth but still slightly textured. Taste. You should have about 3 1/2 cups.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.body: Shred the chicken with two forks and toss with 3/4 cup salsa verde and 1 cup Monterey Jack.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.body: Brush the tortillas lightly on both sides with 1 tbsp oil, stack, wrap in a damp paper towel, and microwave about 60 seconds until pliable (or warm them one at a time in a dry skillet). Warm tortillas roll without cracking.

steps.title: Fill and roll
steps.body: Spread 1/2 cup salsa in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Fill each tortilla with about 1/3 cup filling, roll snugly, and lay seam-side down in two rows. Pour the remaining salsa (about 2 1/4 cups) evenly over, covering the tortilla ends so they don't dry out. Scatter the remaining 1 cup cheese over the top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 425°F until the salsa bubbles at the edges and the cheese is melted with golden spots, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Stir the sour cream with the remaining 1 tbsp lime juice and 1 tbsp water into a drizzle-able lime crema. Rest the enchiladas 3 minutes, then drizzle with crema and scatter the diced onion, radishes, and cilantro leaves. Serve 3 per person. kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.heat: High broiler (heats during prep), then 425°F bake.
recipe_version.doneness: Chicken 175°F and tender before shredding. Salsa bubbling at the edges, cheese melted with golden spots, tortillas soft (not dry at the ends). kitchen_tested is false.
